title: Character creator experiment
question: Mio and Eric can be cut into parts that swap and still walk. Keep going with this?

media.caption: The check sheet. 1: Mio and Eric rebuilt from their own parts next to the game's models (they match). 1b: both walking on Eric's clips. 2: six mixes in idle and walk. 3: close-ups of the neck, waist, ankles and head.
How each model is cut: hair, head, top, bottom, shoes, hands.
The creator page, phone (Eric's body, Mio's hair and hoodie)

options.label: keep: build it out
options.note: Next: more source models through the same cut, fixing the hair gap at the face, an export for the game.

options.label: clothes-only: swap clothes and colours, keep heads whole
options.note: Clothes and colour swaps look clean. Hair and head swaps are the weak part.

options.label: stop: park it
options.note: Keep making each character whole in Meshy.
